mapper.select: SELECT a.*, COALESCE(u.real_name, u.username) as author_name FROM content_article a LEFT JOIN tcm_user u ON a.author_id = u.id WHERE a.status = 1 AND ( a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.summary LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY a.is_featured DESC, (COALESCE(a.comment_count, 0) + COALESCE(a.favorite_count, 0) + COALESCE(a.like_count, 0) + COALESCE(a.view_count, 0)) DESC, COALESCE(a.comment_count, 0) DESC, COALESCE(a.favorite_count, 0) DESC, COALESCE(a.like_count, 0) DESC, COALESCE(a.view_count, 0) DESC, a.is_top DESC, a.publish_time DESC
SELECT a.*, COALESCE(u.real_name, u.username) as author_name FROM content_article a LEFT JOIN tcm_user u ON a.author_id = u.id WHERE a.author_id = #{authorId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC

SELECT a.*, COALESCE(u.real_name, u.username) as author_name FROM content_article a LEFT JOIN tcm_user u ON a.author_id = u.id WHERE a.status = 1 AND a.is_featured = 1 ORDER BY (COALESCE(a.comment_count, 0) + COALESCE(a.favorite_count, 0) + COALESCE(a.like_count, 0) + COALESCE(a.view_count, 0)) DESC, COALESCE(a.comment_count, 0) DESC, COALESCE(a.favorite_count, 0) DESC, COALESCE(a.like_count, 0) DESC, COALESCE(a.view_count, 0) DESC, a.publish_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.*, COALESCE(u.real_name, u.username) as author_name FROM content_article a LEFT JOIN tcm_user u ON a.author_id = u.id WHERE a.status = 1 ORDER BY a.is_featured DESC, (COALESCE(a.comment_count, 0) + COALESCE(a.favorite_count, 0) + COALESCE(a.like_count, 0) + COALESCE(a.view_count, 0)) DESC, COALESCE(a.comment_count, 0) DESC, COALESCE(a.favorite_count, 0) DESC, COALESCE(a.like_count, 0) DESC, COALESCE(a.view_count, 0) DESC, a.publish_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE content_article SET like_count = like_count - 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND like_count > 0
UPDATE content_article SET favorite_count = favorite_count - 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND favorite_count > 0
UPDATE content_article SET comment_count = comment_count - 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND comment_count > 0
